A1.justification: Both complete 21-page PDFs describe KeyTailor and ViT-HD, including Appendices A–J. Pages 2–21 have identical extracted text and rendered images; first-page differences concern author information, the version stamp and slight typesetting.

before.justification: v1 reports original try-on experiments, computational measurements, a user study and ablations in Section 4 and Appendix H, with additional qualitative results in Appendix I.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results, user study, ablations and qualitative comparisons in Section 4 and the appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendices C, E and G retain the same keyframe sampling, garment enhancement, background optimization, LoRA adaptation and generation procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same video datasets, ViT-HD, VVT and ViViD, and image datasets, VITON-HD and DressCode. The in-the-wild and person-to-video scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 2–5 retain identical comparator membership, including DreamVVT in Table 3. The qualitative comparisons and user study also retain their respective comparator sets.

E3.justification: The splits, preprocessing, metrics and experimental settings are identical. Both retain 81-frame training samples, 14,500 training iterations, 25 inference steps and the user study with 80 completed feedback forms.

E4.justification: Table 6 and Figure 8 retain the same component ablations. Appendix H retains the same lambda, alpha and keyframe-count studies, and Appendix I retains the same qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate tables and user-study preference rates. Neither reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative results in the main text and appendices are unchanged. For example, Table 2 reports the same KeyTailor ViT-HD SSIM of 0.9066 and LPIPS of 0.0397 in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(3) and (A1)–(A13), including the score definitions, LoRA formulations and flow-matching objective, are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about keyframe-driven detail injection, computational efficiency, ViT-HD and superior try-on quality.

C2.justification: The interpretations of performance and hyperparameter effects are unchanged. Appendix J retains the same limitations concerning complex garment–body interactions, pretrained model capacity and fine-grained action captioning.

D1.justification: Implementation details, pretrained models, hyperparameters, processing instructions and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. The ViT-HD dataset link is also identical.

R1.justification: The same 47 references and Appendix A related-work discussion are retained, with no change in research positioning or relationships to prior methods.

P1.justification: v2 identifies Xiaobin Hu and Yabiao Wang as corresponding authors through dagger markers and a footnote, changes 'Tencent YouTu Lab' to 'Tencent Youtu Lab,' and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added author markers and expanded footnote cause small first-page typesetting adjustments. All figures and tables retain the same content and design, and pages 2–21 have identical layouts.

improvement.justification: v2 provides administrative clarification of corresponding authorship and affiliation capitalization. The scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information and limitations remain unchanged, so these edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
